Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.web.error

Class GlobalExceptionHandler

java.lang.Object
com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.web.error.GlobalExceptionHandler
@RestControllerAdvice public class GlobalExceptionHandler extends Object
Centralized REST error mapping.

Maps every domain and Spring exception this EPIC emits to the ProblemDetails shape documented in design §9.3. Subsequent feature EPICs add new @ExceptionHandler methods for their own business exceptions; EPIC-14 consolidates the full taxonomy.

Stack traces are logged at ERROR but never returned to the client (REQ-API-004).
